entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Please! He doesn't belong in juvenile[n]detention at all.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I swear I'll make up for the missed[n]practice. Please, let me take just a[n]short break!

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: I've got a few connections up my own[n]sleeve that'll probably be more useful[n]than simply doing your own legwork...

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: I'll also try calling around to check if[n]any of my other trainees have some[n]useful info...

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: But, if I do this for you, it means you're[n]continuing practice as scheduled, got it?[n]I'm sure it's what he'd want for you, too.
